profile.headline: Sr Systems/Software Engineer, Project Managment Professional, Microsoft Certified Professional, IT Systems Security
profile.summary:
Currently fully retired, given the right opportunity would be interested in some part-time work.  Would be seeking short term contract or part-time employment as a technical project manager, opportunities that would benefit from my years of experience and wide skill set.  

In 2013 completed an Information Systems Security, AAS Degree with Honors.   Courses included Microsoft Applications and Operating Systems, Red Hat Linux and Cisco Routers/Switches.  Core Security courses covered OS and Network security details.  I also completed a Computer Forensics course set.

Computer and Network Technologies for over 35 years in the Enterprise & Small to Medium Business (SMB) market space for Life Sciences, Medical Imaging, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Electronics, and Aerospace and Automotive applications

Project Management Institute - Project Management Professional (PMP) certified

Project Management of vendor certification programs with large Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) to complete support-certification on IBM operating systems, servers, storage and software.

Real-time Process Control and high speed database applications in the Electric and Municipal Water Distribution Utilities markets

Over 40 years of experience in security system implementations for both physical security and system / network security.   Have deployed secure systems in both DOD and commercial environments.

Specialties: PMI - PMP Certified
Microsoft Certified Trainer (MCT) - MCSE - MCP
Microsoft Data Center Technical Certification (Clusters)

IBM Power Server/AIX Setup, Installation, Sys Admin

HP Master Accredited Systems Engineer (High Availability & Clusters)

HP StorageWorks Technical Certification (SAN & NAS Disk & Tape Solutions)

DOD Information Assurance Awareness Certification
DOD Information Assurance Security Officer Cert Course

DOD - Inactive Security Clearance in 2012 - held a SECRET Clearance for 42 years thru 2012

positions.title: Sr Systems/Software Engineer-Retired
positions.description:
Enjoying myself in retirement after over 37 years working as a Software/Systems Engineer and 40 years in the US Army Reserve. 

Life is good when you can set your own schedule and get around to some of the Fun Things in life.

positions.title: Student - Information Systems Security
positions.description: 2 year degree in Information Systems Security.  Windows 7, Microsoft Server 2008, Fedora 14 & 15, RH CentOS 6.32-72., VMware Workstation 7.1.6, Cisco Switches & Routers, MySQL, Microsoft Office 2010, numerous Secruity Courses, Computer Forensics

positions.title: Retired Senior Software Engineer ­ - Solutions Certification Manager - Project Manager
positions.description:
Customer-facing relationship management and account leadership responsibility for STG Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) application enablement & certification in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Life Sciences, High Performance Computing, Medical Imaging, Automotive, and Aerospace industries. 

Primary focus on product education, application support, and STG hardware brand solutions including complete project management cycle from initiation to close. Conducted new product announcement and preannouncement disclosures with ISVs for IBM servers, storage, and software offerings.
       
Drove ISV enablement and certification projects resulting in over $300M in STG reportable revenues.
       
Developed full lifecycle work plans and follow through, partnering with matrix teams to develop, track, and complete required project tasks with IBM's ISV Developer Relations,
Software Group, sales teams, and hardware brand representatives. I proposed and led SaaS and Cloud projects to promote ISV applications in an IBM hardware and software environment.
       
Established and maintained partner relationships with ISVs, from team leaders to executives, to develop proper communications channels for contracts, projects and problem resolution.
       
Coordinated with technical consultants to develop and track workflow tasks, problem resolution and sustain high levels of customer satisfaction with IBM business solutions.
       
Developed, planned and executed STG support of ISVs to directly interact with executives and customers, presenting the latest application and product information. Tracked and managed  customer sales opportunity leads with Developer Relations executives and sales teams.

positions.title: OIC Log Warrior training program
positions.locationName: Fort Lee and Fort A.P. Hill in Virginia
positions.description:
Deployed in the US Army Reserve as a Sergeant Major.  I was appointed as the Officer In Charge of a 40 man training detachment for the Quartermaster School.   My team ran a 130 hour Field Training Exercise for QM School soldiers.   

Training was conducted in a 24 hour Operations Tempo in a Forward Operations Base environment.   Goal was to train each soldier on 13 Critical Soldier Combat Skills in a simulated combat environment with Live Fire events.   The team trained over 17,000 soldiers in a 12 month period from 2007-2008.

My mission was to consolidate 2 training sites into a new training venue and double the weekly thru put.   We completed the consolidation with only 2 weeks downtime and doubled the thru put with same instructor headcount in less than 3 months.

positions.title: Senior IT Systems Consultant
positions.description:
Supported Southeast sales region for Tier 1 master distributor of Enterprise-level Servers, Storage, and Networks. Provided pre- and post sales customer-facing technical support for IBM, Digital Equipment Corp, HP/Compaq, CISCO & 3-com products. 

Designed and deployed technical solutions for Enterprise Systems and Enterprise Network requirements.  Designed and deployed large Enterprise Database Servers with Oracle & MS SQL Server. 

Created and delivered technical presentations to inform customers of new products. Provided product update training to the sales staff and customers. 

Earned and maintained numerous Vendor Certifications ­ see list above.
       
Directly contributed to $43M+ sales revenue budget achievement by assisting sales team in project costing, system & network configuration, and quotation preparation.
       
Identified customer's Enterprise IT requirements, evaluated alternatives, and made product recommendations. Provided technically correct configurations to meet customer needs.
       
Managed installation and startup procedures for multi-million dollar Systems & Network projects. Resolved customer satisfaction issues with vendors associated with projects.
       
Evaluated new products and kept current on technological advances through continual vendor training and certification programs. Subject Matter Expert for LAN, WAN & Cluster solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Project Team Leader - Staff Project Engineer
positions.description:
I was the Integration & Delivery Engineering Leader for a large Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System in a real-time computing environment with a Wide Area Network (WAN) in a secure telecom environment.  

I personally managed the delivery and trained the customer to track and validate Acceptance Test results on the Phase 1 integration and acceptance test procedures.  I was designated the responsible person to track and validate Acceptance Test results with the customer contract representative to achieve proper contract milestone signoff.  

I managed a team of 18 Software Engineers and 2 Hardware Engineers.  We utilized software development methodologies based on the Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute best practices guidelines.  Project tasks were tracked using Primavera Project Planner.

positions.title: Systems & Network Manager
positions.description:
Manage in-house development and customer project systems in a Local Area Network.  Provide configuration planning and support to current projects and new proposal activities.  Negotiate and manage Field Service and Software Support contracts for over $600,000 in assets.   Support the project software development team with special system applications and hardware interface applications.

Conduct performance tuning and benchmark testing for the operating system and SCADA applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and develop software for a SCADA System in a real-time computing environment.  Developed the Alarm and Event tracking application.   Develop the System Event Logging application

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop systems to monitor and analyze electric power consumption. Perform system programming, graphical analysis of data, and remote data communications. 

Supervise 6 programmers to design and implement new graphical analysis applications, statistical analysis subsystems and data  conversion applications.

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Programmer
positions.description: Develop, deploy and implement inventory control, order entry and financial reporting systems for automotive parts warehouses, industrial gas suppliers, and retail merchants. Develop user training and documentation.  Responsible for data center, network management and daily operations.

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Programmer
positions.description: Develop and deploy systems for real-time monitoring and control of a manufacturing operation in a 3 node Local Area Network (LAN).  Maintain IBM Host System interface with a Manufacturing Resource Planning system for inventory control and planning.  Perform hardware installation and user training.

positions.title: Industrial Engineer
positions.description: Perform product cost analysis and cost reduction procedures.  Conduct job evaluations.  Conduct the Noise Abatement Program per O.S.H.A. regulations.  Classical Industrial Engineering responsibilities to include project management of in plant engineering projects.   Methods-Time-Motion (MTM) certified.
